description: This file provides utility functions and types for CLI interactions, including directory management, status symbols, spinner animation, and various print functions for formatting output.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: A CLI spinner for indicating progress with start, stop, success, and error feedback.

methods.name: getAgentFieldHomeDir
methods.description: Returns the AgentField home directory, creating necessary subdirectories if they do not exist.

methods.name: PrintSuccess
methods.description: Prints a success message with a checkmark.

methods.name: PrintError
methods.description: Prints an error message with a cross mark.

methods.name: PrintInfo
methods.description: Prints an informational message with an arrow symbol.

methods.name: PrintWarning
methods.description: Prints a warning message with a bullet point symbol.

methods.name: PrintHeader
methods.description: Prints a header message in bold formatting.

methods.name: PrintSubheader
methods.description: Prints a subheader message separated by a newline.

methods.name: PrintBullet
methods.description: Prints a bullet point message with gray bullet symbol.
